name: חֲשַׁבְנְיָה
gloss: Yahweh has regarded me; or Yahweh has reckoned me
summary: The father of Hattush, who repaired the wall (Neh 3:10), and a Levite who called the people to stand and bless Yahweh at the confession of Neh 9 (Neh 9:5). The name reads as חָשַׁב with the suffix “me” and יָה: “Yahweh has regarded me”, as “Adonai thinks on me” (Psa 40:18). Scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: The Levites “Jeshua and Kadmiel, Bani, חֲשַׁבְנְיָה … said: Stand up, bless Yahweh your God from everlasting to everlasting.”

note: Takes h.gr.aj (2 tokens). The analysis חֲשַׁבְנִי + יָה is a reading of the form; no verse gives the meaning.
